flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:5173/ then Open the home page.
Choose the service zone named 'منطقة تجريبية أ' (Test zone A) if a zone must be chosen, then look at the list of meals.
Report for each meal card its title, kitchen name, price and availability, and whether a description paragraph is shown.
Also check whether any filter control for portion size ('one person' / 'two people') is visible.
Assert: (1) three meals are listed: 'وجبة أ١ تجريبية', 'وجبة أ٢ تجريبية', 'وجبة ب١ تجريبية'; (2) each card shows a kitchen name and a price in EGP; (3) the meal 'وجبة موقوفة تجريبية' is NOT listed; (4) no portion-size filter control (one person / two people) is visible.
Get each meal card's title, kitchen name, price, availability, and whether a description paragraph is shown and save it as {{meal_card_details}}.

Update the agent policy to inspect and extract visible results before treating an optional prerequisite as blocking. When cards are already displayed, record their details and run the assertions rather than searching for a zone selector.

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the failed run by repeating the analysis that a zone must be chosen at steps 0-3 and 0-7 instead of reading the visible meal cards, checking the controls, and saving the requested details. The evidence shows no failed UI action, product error, or objective contradiction; the run ended because the agent found no action after overlooking the available information.
